description: This file defines a LocationService class that manages location updates, authorization, and significant location change monitoring using CoreLocation. It provides asynchronous methods for obtaining current location and handling location updates with continuations and streams.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location updates, authorization, and significant change monitoring using CoreLocation, with async/await support and continuations.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures location authorization based on the specified mode.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters, handling timeout and accuracy.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts location updates with desired accuracy, returning an async stream of CLLocation objects.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and monitoring.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback.
